home_title: CodeMaster вЂ” IT Education & Career Platform
home_hero_desc: A platform that turns beginners into developers. Courses with video, audio, presentations and practice, AI assistant, interviews and vacancies.
home_marquee_label: Our students work at the best companies in the world
home_journey_1_title: Every journey starts with a single line
home_journey_1_desc: Remember your first "Hello, World"? That moment when the screen came alive with your code вЂ” that\'s when a developer\'s journey begins. CodeMaster is where the spark becomes a flame.
home_journey_bug_syntax: Code broke. Don\'t give up вЂ” fix it.
home_journey_bug_hint: Hint: Stack Overflow saved the day
home_journey_2_desc: Every developer goes through errors, crashes and sleepless nights debugging. But those who push through become true professionals.
home_journey_2_quote: Every bug is a lesson. Every mistake makes you stronger.
home_journey_3_desc: Your code works. The app is launched. You get the job. Every bug, every sleepless night вЂ” it was all worth it.
home_journey_inf_desc: Technologies change. Languages evolve. But the passion for creation remains. Keep learning, growing and inspiring.
home_leaders_desc: The world\'s most successful developers started exactly where you are now.
home_features_title: Everything you need to get started
home_feature_courses_desc: Frontend, Backend, DevOps, Design. Video, audio and presentations from industry practitioners.
home_feature_roadmaps_desc: Structured paths from beginner to professional. No filler, just what you need.
home_feature_contests_desc: Compete with developers from around the world. Solve problems, climb the ratings.
home_feature_vacancies_desc: Real offers from top companies. Your resume goes directly to HR.
home_feature_ai_desc: Understands your code, finds bugs and guides you to your goal. Instant answers.
home_feature_community_desc: Thousands of developers help each other grow, do code reviews and make connections.
home_courses_desc: Video courses from industry practitioners вЂ” from basics to advanced patterns
home_community_title: Grow together with thousands of developers
home_community_desc: A lively community where you find like-minded people, get feedback and make useful industry connections.
home_cta_desc: Join thousands of developers who are already building their careers with CodeMaster. The first step is the most important.
home_leader_bill_desc: At 15, he wrote a BASIC interpreter. He left Harvard, founded Microsoft and built one of history\'s largest technology companies.
home_leader_bill_quote: If you are born poor, it is not your mistake. But if you die poor, it is your mistake.
home_leader_elon_desc: A self-taught programmer who created Zip2 at 24. Today he leads Tesla, SpaceX and Neuralink, shaping humanity\'s future.
home_leader_elon_quote: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
home_leader_linus_desc: At 21, he created Linux, an operating system that powers much of the world\'s server infrastructure. He later created Git.
home_leader_linus_quote: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
home_leader_mark_desc: He left Harvard and created Facebook at 19. The social network connected billions of people worldwide.
home_leader_mark_quote: Move fast and break things. Unless you are breaking stuff, you are not moving fast enough.
home_leader_larry_desc: He created PageRank and the Google search engine, which became a gateway to the internet for billions of people.
home_leader_larry_quote: If you are working on something you really care about, you do not have to be pushed. The vision pulls you.
home_leader_sam_desc: He led Y Combinator and later became CEO of OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT and GPT-4.
home_leader_sam_quote: AI will be the greatest technological platform in human history.

about.hero_subtitle: We are building the future of IT education, making quality knowledge accessible to every developer worldwide.
about.mission_title: Building the future of IT education
about.mission_p1: CodeMaster was founded with a simple mission: to make quality IT education accessible to everyone. We believe talent is everywhere, and people just need the right opportunities for learning and growth.
about.mission_p2: Our platform combines courses, roadmaps, contests, and employment opportunities, creating a complete ecosystem for developers at any career stage.
about.values_desc: Every decision we make is based on these fundamental values.
about.value_accessibility_desc: Education should be accessible to everyone, regardless of location, age, or financial situation.
about.value_quality_desc: We do not compromise on the quality of content and teaching methods.
about.value_community_desc: The strength of the platform lies in an active community of developers sharing experience.
about.value_practice_desc: Theory without practice is dead. We focus on real projects.
about.value_career_desc: Our goal is to help every student find their dream job in IT.
about.value_innovation_desc: We constantly seek new teaching methods and implement best practices.
about.history_desc: From a small startup to an international educational platform.
about.timeline_founding_desc: Launch of the CodeMaster platform with the first 10 courses and a group of 50 enthusiasts.
about.timeline_growth_desc: Reaching 5,000 students and launching the employment program.
about.timeline_global_desc: Entering the CIS and Southeast Asian markets, over 100 courses in the catalog.
about.timeline_partners_desc: Establishing partnerships with 200+ IT companies for graduate employment.
about.timeline_new_era_desc: Launching an AI platform for personalized learning and mentoring.
about.cta_desc: Start your IT journey today. Over 15,000 students have already changed their lives with us.
